public_content_audit.purpose: Decide whether the exact approved public bytes, metadata, and rights are fit for repository visibility.

launch_audit.hash: sha256 of canonical JSON with audit_digest omitted
required_evidence: one authenticated paginated GitHub API machine lane (gh api --paginate or equivalent authenticated API)
launch_audit.retention: Store the finalized JSON audit, its digest, and the evidence locators in project launch-evidence custody.

required_inputs: sealed candidate metadata and source binding
sealed candidate site inventory and canonical normalized site-inventory digest
rights disposition for every published unit

known_clones_and_cached_views.rule: Known clones, cached views, and unknown external copies may be documented as limitations or findings, but their unprovable absence is never a launch-blocking zero condition.

not_authority_for: GitHub collaborator, team, ruleset, or branch-protection state
GitHub Actions permissions or environment reviewer state
GitHub Pages provider mutation, concurrency, deployment ID, or deployment status

github_control_plane.purpose: Own repository governance and the permissions that authorize the workflow.
required_controls: collaborators, teams, and least-privilege repository roles
default-branch ruleset or branch protection with required review and required checks
GitHub Actions workflow and reusable-action permissions
GitHub Pages source and build-type settings
github-pages environment protection and required reviewers (self-review prevention disabled for the shared eyeyesight account)
repository and organization Actions secret/variable metadata without exposing values

machine_evidence.pagination: Use pagination until every relevant list endpoint is exhausted.

ui_corroboration.role: Human-readable corroboration only; it does not replace the authenticated machine lane.

deployment_plane.purpose: Validate and stage exact approved site bytes, obtain the GitHub-native deployment approval, serialize deployment, and publish through GitHub Actions and GitHub Pages without rebuilding the site.
deployment_plane.provider_authority: GitHub workflow run, github-pages environment gate, Pages artifact, deployment ID, deployment status, and published URL are the provider record of deployment state.
project_responsibilities: validate the sealed artifact and manifest before the deploy job
bind the deploy job to the finalized launch-audit digest and approved rights-authority projection
read back provider IDs and published bytes after provider success
run independent anonymous/browser post-deploy QA after provider success

phases.authority: authenticated GitHub repository/API/UI and anonymous repository readback
project operator after GitHub provider success

lifecycle.cycle_policy: The phase dependency graph is acyclic; deployment approval and post-deploy QA are not launch-audit phases.

branch_layout.main_generated_site_policy: Generated site bytes are committed only to refs/heads/gh-pages; refs/heads/main contains workflow and source code, not the generated site.

delivery.deploy_input_authority: Exact 40-hex site_commit proven to belong to refs/heads/gh-pages; candidate_digest and launch_audit_digest are GitHub-authenticated workflow_dispatch inputs independent of branch bytes; candidate/site inventory digests, manifest/receipt digests, and the approved rights-authority projection are validated before the protected github-pages environment approval.

release_identity.release_id: project release identifier recorded in sealed custody
release_identity.release_digest: sha256 of the canonical project release descriptor
release_identity.generation: project release ordering only; not a GitHub deployment claim
release_identity.authority: project-owned sealed custody identity only; not deployment authority

byte_identity.candidate_digest: sha256 of canonical candidate metadata with candidate_digest omitted
byte_identity.source_artifact_inventory_digest: candidate.source_artifact.artifact_digest: sha256 of the canonical normalized sealed-artifact inventory
byte_identity.candidate_site_inventory_digest: candidate.candidate_site.digest: sha256 of the canonical normalized candidate-site inventory
byte_identity.manifest_digest: sha256 identity of the approved manifest
byte_identity.receipt_digest: sha256 identity of the exact sealed receipt bytes
byte_identity.rights_authority_binding: candidate.rights_authority projection that exactly equals the approved manifest authority; no independent rights digest is invented
byte_identity.launch_audit_digest: sha256 identity of the canonical finalized one-time launch audit

artifact.provider_upload: Upload only site/ from the validated refs/heads/gh-pages site_commit through actions/upload-pages-artifact; never upload .publication metadata and never rebuild or mutate approved bytes.

sealed_custody.authority: project-owned sealed manifest, receipt, approved rights-authority projection, candidate metadata, site inventory, and exact site bytes
records: candidate-site inventory and canonical normalized inventory digest
sealed_custody.rule: A local opaque release or capability may prove custody and byte identity only; it is not deployment authority and is never mutated to record deployment approval. GitHub Actions, the protected github-pages environment, and Pages provider deployment records own deployment authority.

triggers.workflow_dispatch: the only workflow trigger and the only deploy-capable trigger; requires exact site_commit, candidate_digest, and launch_audit_digest inputs and does not bypass either approval

site_commit.description: Exact 40-hex commit SHA that must resolve to the gh-pages source branch.

candidate_digest.description: Expected candidate.candidate_digest supplied as a GitHub-authenticated workflow input.

launch_audit_digest.description: Expected finalized launch-audit digest supplied as a GitHub-authenticated workflow input.

deploy.approval_recorded_in: GitHub github-pages environment review and provider deployment records
must_not: start a second provider mutation after an unknown result

environment.name: github-pages
environment.approval_recorded_in: GitHub github-pages environment review and provider deployment records
environment.url_source: deploy-pages output and GitHub environment URL

concurrency.unknown_outcome_rule: Read back the same workflow run and provider deployment objects; do not infer failure and blindly resubmit.

steps: validation proves site_commit resolves to a commit on refs/heads/gh-pages
validation reads and validates candidate metadata and the finalized launch audit before entering the deploy environment
validation uploads only site/ through actions/upload-pages-artifact
deploy waits for the github-pages environment reviewer and records the environment approval
actions/deploy-pages publishes the Pages artifact and provider records supply deployment/status IDs
read back the workflow run, artifact, deployment, status, environment URL, and published bytes
run post-deploy QA only after provider success and retain its result alongside sealed custody and launch evidence without mutating the sealed receipt
deployment_id_lifecycle.retry_rule: A timeout or unknown provider response is reconciled by readback. A later retry is a new workflow_dispatch run with a new exact site_commit input and must satisfy the normal checks and environment approval.

custom_claim_or_one_start.replacement: GitHub Actions concurrency, github-pages environment approval, and Pages deployment records

trust_boundary.expected_digest_inputs: candidate_digest and launch_audit_digest are GitHub-authenticated workflow_dispatch inputs independent of branch bytes; the verifier compares them to the candidate and finalized audit before deployment.
trust_boundary.human_authority: Tyler uses the approver role on the same eyeyesight GitHub account: the visibility decision is recorded before public mutation, and the specific github-pages environment run is reviewed after validation and exact digest comparison. workflow_run_id, run_started_at, environment_reviewed_at, and the Telegram decision reference correlate the operation but do not prove GitHub identity separation.

github_account_model.limitation: GitHub records only the same eyeyesight account and cannot prove Arke/Tyler role separation; compromise of the eyeyesight account can simultaneously initiate and approve both human decisions.

source_root.description: The prepare CLI requires the operator to supply the canonical source-tree root and rejects an output root that overlaps this authority.

candidate_cleanup.parent_and_output_staging_root: trusted against cooperating same-user replacement during cleanup
candidate_cleanup.method: best-effort non-recursive rmdir of the checked empty directory
candidate_cleanup.checks_before_rmdir: no-link and matching dev/ino checks immediately before rmdir
candidate_cleanup.resistance: does not claim resistance to a compromised or cooperating same-user writer

limitations: This boundary does not provide cryptographic resistance to a malicious launcher or prove that a launcher selected the approved digest set.
No custom signing, token, claim, or custom deployment authority is introduced; GitHub environment and deployment records remain authoritative for deployment approval.
Candidate cleanup is not an absolute atomic replacement guarantee; its trusted parent/output staging-root assumption excludes compromised or cooperating same-user writers.

GitHub records only the eyeyesight account for both logical roles; run IDs, run/approval timestamps, and Telegram decision references are operator correlation evidence, not cryptographic proof of Arke/Tyler identity separation.
If the eyeyesight account is compromised, the same account can simultaneously initiate and approve both the visibility and deployment decisions.

visibility.before: repository visibility change or public-content exposure

deployment.recorded_in: GitHub github-pages environment review and provider deployment records

post_deploy_qa.authority: project operator after GitHub provider success
checks: anonymous HTTP request to the expected Pages URL
anonymous browser navigation and representative route checks
canonical candidate site inventory digest or approved derived-byte manifest
GitHub deployment status and environment URL readback
post_deploy_qa.result: Record pass, findings, or blocked independently of the provider deployment result; QA is never a pre-deploy input.

legacy_31_surface_four_lane.replacement: one-time launch audit plus GitHub-native control and deployment evidence

legacy_opaque_capability.replacement: sealed artifact hash and GitHub workflow/environment/provider records

legacy_custom_atomic_claim_one_start.replacement: GitHub Actions concurrency and provider deployment IDs

migration.rule: The generated site is now modeled as a tracked gh-pages branch transport. Project-owned sealed custody, rights, candidate metadata, and launch-audit evidence remain inputs; GitHub-native workflow, environment, provider records, and readback own deployment state.
